comparison.objective: Put a drain pan under an engine outlet before removing its drain plug and store the plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered pan placement, axial plug extraction, and small-part placement.
comparison.success_condition: The pan must remain under the outlet whenever the plug is out; full score also requires the plug in the parts dish.
comparison.reason: It shares ordered removal and containment of a small part, but tests direct plug extraction and spill prevention, not coaxial impact fracture while preserving an insert and recovering four newly freed tangs.
